evaluation: offline; authored replay only; no provider or semantic judge

answer_replay.gold: Closed-world typed fact ledger, independently scored from supplied review verdicts; scripted claims are rendered deterministically from their propositions.
answer_replay.control: Both citation hosts verify current snapshot identity, nonempty claims and selected citations. The reviewed host additionally calls the actual v0.11.0 check_answer API. This is an application-adoption experiment, not a native v0.10.0 hallucination rate.
primary_metrics: fully supported and cited answer yield
false refusals of initially valid answers
acceptance: Citation-only host outputs match between versions
Reviewed host has zero erroneous releases in the honest-review stratum
Initially valid reviewed controls retain full answer yield
Repairable honest-review episodes finish within two attempts
Reviewer-error controls remain visible and are never scored using reviewer verdicts as gold

performance.timing: End-to-end worker RPC including JSON serialization, IPC, graph compilation, native snapshot verification and response parsing. Source-refresh measurements include replacing the complete source and compiling the affected request. Warmup, transcript writing, Python validation and worker startup excluded; startup reported separately.
performance.correctness: Every complete response matches between versions at the same sequence position. Required IDs, exact token cap, expected errors, source refresh and cache bounds are checked.
performance.statistics: Alternate version order; bootstrap eight paired process-session medians, never individual repeated requests; deterministic 2000 draws.
performance.improvement_threshold: At least 10% paired median latency reduction and the descriptive 95% interval entirely above zero for a workload. Otherwise report improvement not established; do not tune fixtures after measurement.
performance.resource_watch: Report per-process peak RSS and cache occupancy; flag a default-cache median RSS increase greater than 20%.

limitations: Authored facts and scripted drafts do not measure real-model hallucination prevalence or calibration
Reviews are a host trust assumption, not supplied by CIGAR
Persistent BPE-worker gains do not imply gains in Hiero's fresh-process UTF-8 adapter
Same-host timing does not establish cross-platform performance
EVM prompt overflow and generic-retrieval diagnostics remain separate Hiero integration issues
